------
Order No.05 / Dated : 13.09.2024 The petitioners are apprehending their arrest, the petitioners
named above have moved this Court for grant of anticipatory bail in connection with Katkamsandi
P.S. Case No. 404/2023, registered under Sections 147, 148, 149, 341, 323, 324, 307, 379 and 506 of
the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate-1st Class, Hazaribag.
As per the F.I.R., incidence took place on 16.09.2023.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the present case is counter blast to Katkamsandi P.S. Case No. 403 of 2023, which was filed by the wife of petitioner no. 1 against two named and one unknown accused person under Sections 341, 323, 324, 307, 354, 376, 511, 379, 504, 506, 34 of IPC.
In the present case, general and omnibus allegations have been levelled against altogether eight persons.

entities.text: Ramesh Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that there is direct and specific allegation against these petitioners in a premeditated attack had caused grievous injury to Abhishek Kumar which included fracture of right parietal temporal bone.
Under the circumstance, I do not find any merit in this anticipatory bail application.

Accordingly,
the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner, is hereby rejected and petitioners are directed to surrender before the Trail Court within two weeks from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order.

(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Pawan/-
